writing.explanation: Rust infers whether a closure needs a shared borrow (Fn), a mutable borrow (FnMut), or ownership (FnOnce) from what the body does. `move` forces capture by value, which is what makes a closure safe to send to another thread — the ownership question is answered at compile time rather than by a convention.
